children: UK-based leisure tech provider's H1 revenue was flat, reflecting offset in product mix
Adjusted EPS rose 27% and cash EBITDA increased 50% on cost actions
Company returned $20 mln to shareholders via tender offer in March
Accesso expects FY26 revenue of about $146 mln and Cash EBITDA of about $20 mln
Company says full-year performance remains weighted toward H2 due to seasonality
Accesso notes some FY26 revenue depends on Middle East project milestone deliveries
PRODUCT MIX SHIFT - Growth in ticketing and distribution revenue offset by sharp decline in guest experience revenue due to virtual queuing contract changes
COST EFFICIENCY - Cash EBITDA rose due to cost actions and a 6.1% reduction in underlying administrative expenditure
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Accesso Technology Group PLC is GBp525.00, about 71% above its September 14 closing price of GBp307.00
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
Sept 14 - UK government hosts meeting with business leaders to discuss growth
